purpose: Prove one real System account maps to a canonical Principal, owns an approved and activated Merchant/Shop, publishes an authorized Listing, and operates one canonical Warehouse/Zone/Location mapped from a real ERP warehouse.

source_inputs.system_admin_source_id: required existing active SYSTEM/SYSTEM_ADMIN_USER source backed by system_users.id in the selected tenant
source_inputs.erp_warehouse_source_id: required existing non-deleted erp_warehouse.id in the selected tenant

source_identity_policy: Resolve and reuse an existing ACTIVE System source link; create it only when absent. Reuse is read-only and reduces public writes from 21 to 20.
warehouse_network_policy: Resolve and reuse an existing ready Warehouse/Zone/Location network for the exact ERP source; create and map the network only when absent. Reuse removes eight public writes.
listing_policy: proof publishes one authorization Listing for standalone master-data verification; defer creates no Listing and delegates the single business Listing to the downstream commerce Skill.
writes: merchant onboarding DRAFT -> SUBMITTED -> UNDER_REVIEW -> APPROVED
listing DRAFT -> SUBMITTED -> COMPLETION_PASSED -> BUSINESS_APPROVED -> RISK_APPROVED -> PUBLISHED
invariants: principal_id is not the System source account ID
Merchant, Shop, LegalEntity, and Principal IDs are pairwise distinct
the active Shop belongs to the active Merchant and has exactly one active OWNER assignment
Listing creation and publication use the exact active Merchant, Shop, channel, Principal, and OWNER assignment
the canonical warehouse ID is not the ERP warehouse source ID
the active Location belongs to the active Zone and Warehouse
the ERP source mapping resolves to the exact canonical warehouse
all public write commands replay as immutable duplicates: proof mode uses 12/13/20/21 writes and deferred mode uses 6/7/14/15 according to safe source-link and Warehouse-network reuse
forbidden_shortcuts: default or fabricated Principal, Merchant, Shop, Warehouse, Zone, or Location
copying system_users.id or erp_warehouse.id into a canonical ID
direct table writes by the runner
raw PII, credentials, or source warehouse names in the ledger
empty readiness views as acceptance evidence
cleanup: No destructive cleanup. Resources are run-scoped and retained with operation, history, Outbox, CDC, and reconciliation evidence.
